description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the relationship between the "Number of Shots" and the value "$\gamma_B$". The horizontal category axis is labeled "Number of Shots" and displays discrete numerical categories ordered sequentially from 0 to 4. The vertical value axis is labeled "$\gamma_B$" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6) and corresponding horizontal dotted grid lines. A legend at the top displays three patterned or colored boxes: a blue box with a dotted pattern that lacks a text label, a solid light gray box that also lacks a text label, and a magenta box with diagonal stripes labeled "Correct". Within the chart area, data is represented by grouped pairs of bars for each category on the x-axis, consisting of a blue dotted bar on the left and a magenta striped bar on the right; the solid gray category from the legend does not appear in the plotted data. All bars feature solid black outlines to provide visual emphasis. Across the categories from 0 to 4, the heights of both the blue dotted bars and the magenta striped bars exhibit a consistent downward trend. The blue dotted bars range from a maximum approximate value of 0.41 at 0 shots to a minimum of 0.30 at 4 shots. The magenta striped bars, representing the "Correct" category, range from a maximum approximate value of 0.72 at 0 shots to a minimum of 0.45 at 4 shots.
